Stage 7: NeuralForge Platform

Lecture 51: Final Capstone — Deploy Your Complete LLM System

From Zero to Deployed — Your AI Journey Is Complete

~35 min read | Beginner–Intermediate | The final lecture

Congratulations — You Made It

Take a moment to appreciate what you have accomplished. Fifty-one lectures ago, you started with a simple question: “What is a language model?” Today, you have the answer — not just in theory, but in practice. You built one.

Here is the journey you completed:

  • Stage 1 — Foundations: You learned what tokens are, how text becomes numbers, and why that matters.
  • Stage 2 — Embeddings: You built embedding layers that give meaning to numbers, and positional encodings that give meaning to order.
  • Stage 3 — Attention: You implemented the attention mechanism — the core innovation that makes modern AI possible. You understand why it works, not just that it works.
  • Stage 4 — Architecture: You assembled a complete GPT-2 transformer from scratch — multi-head attention, feed-forward networks, layer normalization, the full stack.
  • Stage 5 — Training: You trained your model with real data using loss functions, optimizers, and learning rate scheduling. You watched the loss curve drop and understood what each number meant.
  • Stage 6 — Fine-tuning: You learned LoRA, RAG, quantization, and domain specialization — the techniques that turn a base model into a useful tool.
  • Stage 7 — Platform: You built NeuralForge, connected it to five SaaS products, and learned the business side of AI — costs, prompting, and deployment.
What You Built: A complete, working LLM system with a visual training platform, API endpoints, connections to five AI-powered SaaS products, and the knowledge to deploy it all to the internet. Most computer science graduates cannot say they have done this.

1. What You Now Have

Let’s take inventory of everything you built and learned:

Your Trained Mini GPT-2 Language Model

  • A transformer-based language model with ~85 million parameters
  • Character-level tokenization that you built yourself
  • Multi-head self-attention (you coded every matrix multiplication)
  • Feed-forward networks with GELU activation
  • Layer normalization and residual connections
  • Autoregressive text generation with temperature and top-k sampling

Your NeuralForge Platform

  • Visual training interface — watch your model learn in real time
  • Fine-tuning controls — adjust your model for specific tasks
  • API Generator — create integration code for any SaaS product
  • Playground — test prompts and system messages interactively
  • Model evaluation — measure quality with multiple metrics

Five GenAI SaaS Product Integrations

  • PixelForge — image prompt enhancement
  • ClipCraft — video script generation
  • ProseAI — text rewriting in multiple modes
  • TruthLens — text analysis and pattern detection
  • DocMind — document Q&A and summarization

Professional Knowledge

  • AI API costs across six major providers (Lecture 48)
  • Prompt engineering techniques for production systems (Lecture 49)
  • Integration architecture for AI-powered SaaS products (Lecture 50)
  • Deployment workflows for web applications

2. Step-by-Step Deployment Guide

This guide is written for beginners. No command line required. No terminal. Just your web browser and a few clicks.

Before You Start: Make sure you have scored at least 80% across all quizzes in the course. This is required to download the complete project zip file from NeuralForge.

Step 1: Download Your Project from NeuralForge

  1. Open NeuralForge in your browser
  2. Navigate to the “Export” or “Download” section
  3. Check that your quiz score shows 80% or higher
  4. Click “Download Project ZIP”
  5. Save the file to your computer (it will be named something like neuralforge-project.zip)
  6. Unzip the file — right-click and select “Extract All” (Windows) or double-click (Mac)

You should now have a folder containing your complete project: model code, frontend, API endpoints, configuration files, and everything needed for deployment.

Step 2: Create a GitHub Repository

  1. Go to github.com in your browser
  2. Sign in (or create a free account if you do not have one)
  3. Click the + button in the top right corner
  4. Select “New repository”
  5. Name it my-neuralforge-llm (or any name you like)
  6. Set it to Public (required for free Vercel deployment)
  7. Check “Add a README file”
  8. Click “Create repository”

Step 3: Upload Your Project Files

  1. On your new repository page, click “uploading an existing file” (the link appears in the quick setup section)
  2. Open your unzipped project folder on your computer
  3. Select all files and folders inside the project folder
  4. Drag them into the upload area on GitHub
  5. Wait for all files to upload (this may take a minute)
  6. Scroll down and click “Commit changes”
Large Files: If GitHub says a file is too large (over 25 MB), you may need to remove model weight files from the upload. The platform code will work without pre-trained weights — users can train the model through the NeuralForge interface.

Step 4: Deploy to Vercel

  1. Go to vercel.com in your browser
  2. Click “Sign Up” and sign in with your GitHub account
  3. Click “Add New...” → “Project”
  4. You will see a list of your GitHub repositories
  5. Find my-neuralforge-llm and click “Import”
  6. Vercel will auto-detect the framework — leave the defaults
  7. Click “Deploy”
  8. Wait 1–2 minutes while Vercel builds and deploys your project

Step 5: Your LLM Is Live!

When the deployment finishes, Vercel will show you a URL like:

https://my-neuralforge-llm.vercel.app

Click it. Your NeuralForge LLM platform is now live on the internet. Anyone with the URL can access it. Share it with friends, add it to your portfolio, put it on your LinkedIn profile.

You just deployed an AI application to the internet. That is a real accomplishment.

Step 6: Set Environment Variables (Optional)

If you want to enable commercial API fallback (so your SaaS products can use OpenAI or Gemini when your custom model is not enough), add environment variables in Vercel:

  1. In your Vercel dashboard, click on your project
  2. Go to “Settings” → “Environment Variables”
  3. Add the keys you need:
    • OPENAI_API_KEY = your OpenAI key
    • GOOGLE_API_KEY = your Google AI key (free!)
  4. Click “Save”
  5. Go to “Deployments” and click “Redeploy” on the latest deployment

3. Connecting Your SaaS Products

Now that your LLM is deployed, you can connect it to each of the five GenAI SaaS products you built.

For Each SaaS Product:

  1. Open the SaaS project in your code editor or GitHub
  2. Find the .env file (or .env.local)
  3. Set the LLM_URL to your deployed NeuralForge URL: 
    LLM_URL=https://my-neuralforge-llm.vercel.app
  4. If the SaaS product is also deployed on Vercel, add this environment variable in the Vercel dashboard for that project
  5. Redeploy the SaaS project

That is it. Your SaaS products are now connected to your deployed LLM. When a user interacts with PixelForge, ProseAI, or any of the other products, the requests flow to your NeuralForge server.

4. Setting Up Your Local Development Environment

While your deployed version runs on Vercel, you may also want to run the project locally for training and experimentation.

Install Python

  1. Go to python.org
  2. Click the big “Download Python” button
  3. Run the installer
    • Important (Windows): Check the box that says “Add Python to PATH” before clicking Install
    • Mac: Follow the default installation steps
  4. Verify: open a terminal or command prompt and type python --version — you should see Python 3.10 or higher

Install Dependencies

Your project includes a requirements.txt file with all the Python packages you need. Open a terminal in the project folder and run:

pip install -r requirements.txt

This installs PyTorch, FastAPI, and all other dependencies.

Using an IDE

For the best experience, use a code editor:

  • VS Code (free): Download from code.visualstudio.com. Open your project folder with File → Open Folder.
  • PyCharm Community (free): Download from jetbrains.com/pycharm. It automatically detects Python projects.

5. What to Learn Next

You have built a solid foundation. Here are the most impactful next steps, ordered by difficulty:

Beginner Next Steps

  • Try BPE tokenization: Replace your character-level tokenizer with Byte Pair Encoding for much better text handling. The HuggingFace tokenizers library makes this easy.
  • Train on more data: Your model improves with more training data. Try Wikipedia articles, public domain books, or code from GitHub.
  • Experiment with hyperparameters: Try different learning rates, batch sizes, and model sizes. See how each change affects quality.

Intermediate Next Steps

  • HuggingFace Transformers: The transformers library gives you access to thousands of pre-trained models. Try loading GPT-2 (the full version) or LLaMA.
  • Fine-tune on your own data: Collect data from your domain (business emails, customer support tickets, code repositories) and fine-tune a model specifically for your use case.
  • Connect to real commercial APIs: Use OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google APIs for production-quality responses while keeping your custom model for learning and experimentation.
  • Build more SaaS products: The pattern you learned (LLM + system prompt + API) can be applied to any text-based application.

Advanced Next Steps

  • Scale up the model: Increase the number of layers, attention heads, and embedding dimensions. A 300M parameter model is within reach on a good GPU.
  • Implement RLHF: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback is the technique used to train ChatGPT. It is the next frontier after supervised fine-tuning.
  • Multi-modal models: Add image or audio processing capabilities to your model.
  • Distributed training: Learn to train across multiple GPUs or machines using PyTorch DDP or DeepSpeed.

6. The Potential of What You Built

Your LLM knowledge opens the door to building:

Practical Applications

  • Chatbots and virtual assistants: Customer support, FAQ bots, personal assistants
  • Content generation: Blog posts, social media content, email templates, marketing copy
  • Code generation and analysis: Autocomplete, bug detection, code review, documentation generation
  • Document processing: Summarization, Q&A, data extraction, translation
  • Education: Personalized tutoring, quiz generation, explanations at different levels
  • Creative writing: Story generation, poetry, screenwriting assistance

Business Opportunities

  • AI consulting: Companies need people who understand LLMs deeply, not just how to use ChatGPT
  • Custom AI solutions: Build tailored AI tools for specific industries (legal, medical, finance)
  • SaaS products: The five products you built in this course are just the beginning
  • Training and workshops: Teach others what you learned — the demand for AI education is enormous
Your Competitive Advantage: Most people using AI tools have no idea how they work. You built one from scratch. You understand attention mechanisms, training dynamics, loss functions, and tokenization at a fundamental level. This knowledge makes you stand out in any AI-related role.

7. Course Certificate and Project Download

Completing the Course

To officially complete the ADD Academy LLM Course:

  1. Score at least 80% across all quizzes (check your progress in the course dashboard)
  2. Download your complete project ZIP from NeuralForge
  3. Deploy it to Vercel (or any hosting platform)

What Is in the ZIP

The complete project ZIP contains everything:

  • Model code: Your Mini GPT-2 implementation with all components
  • Frontend: The NeuralForge React/Next.js application
  • API: FastAPI endpoints for chat, generation, and training
  • Integration code: Generated API code for all five SaaS products
  • Configuration: requirements.txt, vercel.json, .env.example
  • Documentation: Setup instructions and API reference

You Own the Code

The code you built in this course is yours. You can:

  • Modify it however you want
  • Extend it with new features
  • Use it in your portfolio
  • Use it commercially
  • Share it with others
  • Build a business on top of it

8. Thank You and Community

Building a language model from scratch is hard. The math is dense. The code is complex. The concepts are abstract until they suddenly click. You persisted through 51 lectures, dozens of code blocks, and hundreds of concepts. That persistence is the most valuable skill in technology.

What You Proved to Yourself

  • You can understand complex AI concepts
  • You can build real software from scratch
  • You can deploy applications to the internet
  • You can learn anything if you commit to it

Join the Community

  • Share your deployed NeuralForge project with the ADD Academy community
  • Help other students who are working through the course
  • Show off your projects — post your Vercel URL on social media
  • Keep building — the best way to learn is to keep creating

Stay Connected

The field of AI moves fast. What you learned in this course is foundational — the principles do not change even as the models get bigger and the tools get better. Transformers, attention, tokenization, training dynamics, prompt engineering — these are the permanent building blocks of modern AI.

Keep learning. Keep building. Keep pushing the boundaries of what you think is possible.

You are no longer just a user of AI. You are a builder of AI.

Welcome to the future. You helped build it.

Etapa 7: Platforma NeuralForge

Lecția 51: Capstone Final — Implementarea Sistemului Complet LLM

De la Zero la Implementat — Călătoria Ta în AI Este Completă

~35 min de citit | Începător–Intermediar | Lecția finală

Felicitări — Ai Reușit

Ia-ți un moment pentru a aprecia ceea ce ai realizat. Cu cincizeci și una de lecții în urmă, ai început cu o întrebare simplă: “Ce este un model de limbaj?” Astăzi, ai răspunsul — nu doar în teorie, ci în practică. L-ai construit.

Iată călătoria pe care ai parcurs-o:

  • Etapa 1 — Fundamente: Ai învățat ce sunt tokenii, cum textul devine numere și de ce contează.
  • Etapa 2 — Embeddings: Ai construit straturi de embedding care dau sens numerelor și codificări poziționale care dau sens ordinii.
  • Etapa 3 — Atenție: Ai implementat mecanismul de atenție — inovația de bază care face posibil AI-ul modern. Înțelegi de ce funcționează, nu doar că funcționează.
  • Etapa 4 — Arhitectură: Ai asamblat un transformer GPT-2 complet de la zero — atenție multi-head, rețele feed-forward, normalizare pe straturi, întreaga stivă.
  • Etapa 5 — Antrenament: Ți-ai antrenat modelul cu date reale folosind funcții de pierdere, optimizatori și programarea ratei de învățare. Ai urmărit curba de pierdere scăzând și ai înțeles ce înseamnă fiecare număr.
  • Etapa 6 — Fine-tuning: Ai învățat LoRA, RAG, cuantizare și specializare de domeniu — tehnicile care transformă un model de bază într-un instrument util.
  • Etapa 7 — Platformă: Ai construit NeuralForge, l-ai conectat la cinci produse SaaS și ai învățat partea de business a AI-ului — costuri, prompting și implementare.
Ce Ai Construit: Un sistem LLM complet, funcțional, cu o platformă vizuală de antrenament, endpoint-uri API, conexiuni la cinci produse SaaS alimentate de AI și cunoștințele pentru a le implementa pe toate pe internet. Majoritatea absolvenților de informatică nu pot spune că au făcut asta.

1. Ce Ai Acum

Să facem inventarul a tot ce ai construit și învățat:

Modelul Tău de Limbaj Mini GPT-2 Antrenat

  • Un model de limbaj bazat pe transformer cu ~85 milioane de parametri
  • Tokenizare la nivel de caracter pe care ai construit-o tu
  • Auto-atenție multi-head (ai codat fiecare înmulțire de matrice)
  • Rețele feed-forward cu activare GELU
  • Normalizare pe straturi și conexiuni reziduale
  • Generare de text autoregresivă cu eșantionare prin temperatură și top-k

Platforma Ta NeuralForge

  • Interfață vizuală de antrenament — urmărește cum învață modelul tău în timp real
  • Controale de fine-tuning — ajustează modelul pentru sarcini specifice
  • Generator de API — creează cod de integrare pentru orice produs SaaS
  • Playground — testează prompturi și mesaje de sistem interactiv
  • Evaluarea modelului — măsoară calitatea cu mai multe metrici

Cinci Integrări de Produse GenAI SaaS

  • PixelForge — îmbunătățirea prompturilor pentru imagini
  • ClipCraft — generarea de scenarii video
  • ProseAI — rescrierea textului în mai multe moduri
  • TruthLens — analiza textului și detectarea tiparelor
  • DocMind — întrebări și răspunsuri pe documente și rezumare

Cunoștințe Profesionale

  • Costurile API-urilor AI de la șase furnizori majori (Lecția 48)
  • Tehnici de inginerie a prompturilor pentru sisteme de producție (Lecția 49)
  • Arhitectura de integrare pentru produse SaaS alimentate de AI (Lecția 50)
  • Fluxuri de lucru de implementare pentru aplicații web

2. Ghid de Implementare Pas cu Pas

Acest ghid este scris pentru începători. Nu este necesară linia de comandă. Niciun terminal. Doar browserul tău web și câteva clicuri.

Înainte de a Începe: Asigură-te că ai obținut cel puțin 80% la toate chestionarele din curs. Aceasta este necesar pentru a descărca fișierul zip complet al proiectului din NeuralForge.

Pasul 1: Descarcă Proiectul din NeuralForge

  1. Deschide NeuralForge în browser
  2. Navighează la secțiunea “Export” sau “Download”
  3. Verifică dacă scorul tău la chestionare arată 80% sau mai mult
  4. Dă clic pe “Download Project ZIP”
  5. Salvează fișierul pe computer (va fi denumit ceva de genul neuralforge-project.zip)
  6. Dezarhivează fișierul — clic dreapta și selectează “Extract All” (Windows) sau dublu clic (Mac)

Acum ar trebui să ai un folder care conține proiectul tău complet: codul modelului, frontend-ul, endpoint-urile API, fișierele de configurare și tot ce este necesar pentru implementare.

Pasul 2: Creează un Depozit GitHub

  1. Accesează github.com în browser
  2. Conectează-te (sau creează un cont gratuit dacă nu ai unul)
  3. Dă clic pe butonul + din colțul din dreapta sus
  4. Selectează “New repository”
  5. Numește-l my-neuralforge-llm (sau orice nume dorești)
  6. Setează-l ca Public (necesar pentru implementarea gratuită pe Vercel)
  7. Bifează “Add a README file”
  8. Dă clic pe “Create repository”

Pasul 3: Încarcă Fișierele Proiectului

  1. Pe pagina noului tău depozit, dă clic pe “uploading an existing file” (linkul apare în secțiunea de configurare rapidă)
  2. Deschide folderul proiectului dezarhivat pe computer
  3. Selectează toate fișierele și folderele din folderul proiectului
  4. Trage-le în zona de încărcare de pe GitHub
  5. Așteaptă ca toate fișierele să se încarce (poate dura un minut)
  6. Derulează în jos și dă clic pe “Commit changes”
Fișiere Mari: Dacă GitHub spune că un fișier este prea mare (peste 25 MB), ar putea fi necesar să elimini fișierele de greutăți ale modelului din încărcare. Codul platformei va funcționa fără greutăți pre-antrenate — utilizatorii pot antrena modelul prin interfața NeuralForge.

Pasul 4: Implementează pe Vercel

  1. Accesează vercel.com în browser
  2. Dă clic pe “Sign Up” și conectează-te cu contul tău GitHub
  3. Dă clic pe “Add New...” → “Project”
  4. Vei vedea o listă cu depozitele tale GitHub
  5. Găsește my-neuralforge-llm și dă clic pe “Import”
  6. Vercel va detecta automat framework-ul — lasă valorile implicite
  7. Dă clic pe “Deploy”
  8. Așteaptă 1–2 minute în timp ce Vercel construiește și implementează proiectul tău

Pasul 5: LLM-ul Tău Este Live!

Când implementarea se termină, Vercel îți va arăta un URL de genul:

https://my-neuralforge-llm.vercel.app

Dă clic pe el. Platforma ta NeuralForge LLM este acum live pe internet. Oricine cu URL-ul poate accesa. Împărtășește-l cu prietenii, adaugă-l în portofoliul tău, pune-l pe profilul tău LinkedIn.

Tocmai ai implementat o aplicație AI pe internet. Aceasta este o realizare reală.

Pasul 6: Setează Variabilele de Mediu (Opțional)

Dacă vrei să activezi fallback-ul la API-uri comerciale (astfel încât produsele tale SaaS să poată folosi OpenAI sau Gemini când modelul tău personalizat nu este suficient), adaugă variabile de mediu în Vercel:

  1. În tabloul de bord Vercel, dă clic pe proiectul tău
  2. Accesează “Settings” → “Environment Variables”
  3. Adaugă cheile de care ai nevoie:
    • OPENAI_API_KEY = cheia ta OpenAI
    • GOOGLE_API_KEY = cheia ta Google AI (gratuită!)
  4. Dă clic pe “Save”
  5. Accesează “Deployments” și dă clic pe “Redeploy” pe ultima implementare

3. Conectarea Produselor Tale SaaS

Acum că LLM-ul tău este implementat, îl poți conecta la fiecare dintre cele cinci produse GenAI SaaS pe care le-ai construit.

Pentru Fiecare Produs SaaS:

  1. Deschide proiectul SaaS în editorul de cod sau GitHub
  2. Găsește fișierul .env (sau .env.local)
  3. Setează LLM_URL la URL-ul NeuralForge implementat: 
    LLM_URL=https://my-neuralforge-llm.vercel.app
  4. Dacă produsul SaaS este de asemenea implementat pe Vercel, adaugă această variabilă de mediu în tabloul de bord Vercel pentru acel proiect
  5. Reimplementează proiectul SaaS

Atât. Produsele tale SaaS sunt acum conectate la LLM-ul tău implementat. Când un utilizator interacționează cu PixelForge, ProseAI sau oricare dintre celelalte produse, cererile ajung la serverul tău NeuralForge.

4. Configurarea Mediului de Dezvoltare Locală

În timp ce versiunea implementată rulează pe Vercel, s-ar putea să vrei să rulezi proiectul și local pentru antrenament și experimentare.

Instalează Python

  1. Accesează python.org
  2. Dă clic pe butonul mare “Download Python”
  3. Rulează programul de instalare
    • Important (Windows): Bifează caseta care spune “Add Python to PATH” înainte de a da clic pe Install
    • Mac: Urmează pașii de instalare impliciți
  4. Verifică: deschide un terminal sau prompt de comandă și tastează python --version — ar trebui să vezi Python 3.10 sau mai recent

Instalează Dependențele

Proiectul tău include un fișier requirements.txt cu toate pachetele Python de care ai nevoie. Deschide un terminal în folderul proiectului și rulează:

pip install -r requirements.txt

Aceasta instalează PyTorch, FastAPI și toate celelalte dependențe.

Utilizarea unui IDE

Pentru cea mai bună experiență, folosește un editor de cod:

  • VS Code (gratuit): Descarcă de la code.visualstudio.com. Deschide folderul proiectului cu File → Open Folder.
  • PyCharm Community (gratuit): Descarcă de la jetbrains.com/pycharm. Detectează automat proiectele Python.

5. Ce Să Înveți în Continuare

Ai construit o fundație solidă. Iată cei mai importanți pași următori, ordonați după dificultate:

Pași Următori pentru Începători

  • Încearcă tokenizarea BPE: Înlocuiește tokenizer-ul la nivel de caracter cu Byte Pair Encoding pentru o gestionare mult mai bună a textului. Biblioteca tokenizers de la HuggingFace face asta ușor.
  • Antrenează cu mai multe date: Modelul tău se îmbunătățește cu mai multe date de antrenament. Încearcă articole Wikipedia, cărți din domeniul public sau cod de pe GitHub.
  • Experimentează cu hiperparametri: Încearcă diferite rate de învățare, dimensiuni de lot și dimensiuni ale modelului. Observă cum fiecare schimbare afectează calitatea.

Pași Următori pentru Nivel Intermediar

  • HuggingFace Transformers: Biblioteca transformers îți oferă acces la mii de modele pre-antrenate. Încearcă să încarci GPT-2 (versiunea completă) sau LLaMA.
  • Fine-tuning pe datele tale: Colectează date din domeniul tău (emailuri de afaceri, tichete de suport clienți, depozite de cod) și perfecționează un model specific pentru cazul tău de utilizare.
  • Conectează-te la API-uri comerciale reale: Folosește API-urile OpenAI, Anthropic sau Google pentru răspunsuri de calitate pentru producție, păstrând în același timp modelul personalizat pentru învățare și experimentare.
  • Construiește mai multe produse SaaS: Tiparul pe care l-ai învățat (LLM + prompt de sistem + API) poate fi aplicat oricărei aplicații bazate pe text.

Pași Următori Avansați

  • Mărește modelul: Crește numărul de straturi, capete de atenție și dimensiuni de embedding. Un model de 300M parametri este la îndemână pe un GPU bun.
  • Implementează RLHF: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback este tehnica folosită pentru a antrena ChatGPT. Este următoarea frontieră după fine-tuning-ul supervizat.
  • Modele multi-modale: Adaugă capabilități de procesare a imaginilor sau audio la modelul tău.
  • Antrenament distribuit: Învață să antrenezi pe mai multe GPU-uri sau mașini folosind PyTorch DDP sau DeepSpeed.

6. Potențialul a Ceea Ce Ai Construit

Cunoștințele tale despre LLM deschid ușa pentru a construi:

Aplicații Practice

  • Chatboți și asistenți virtuali: Suport clienți, roboți FAQ, asistenți personali
  • Generarea de conținut: Postări de blog, conținut pentru rețele sociale, șabloane de email, texte de marketing
  • Generarea și analiza codului: Autocompletare, detectarea bugurilor, revizuirea codului, generarea documentației
  • Procesarea documentelor: Rezumare, Q&A, extragerea datelor, traducere
  • Educație: Tutoriat personalizat, generarea de chestionare, explicații la diferite niveluri
  • Scriere creativă: Generarea de povești, poezie, asistență pentru scenaristică

Oportunități de Afaceri

  • Consultanță AI: Companiile au nevoie de oameni care înțeleg LLM-urile în profunzime, nu doar cum să folosească ChatGPT
  • Soluții AI personalizate: Construiește instrumente AI adaptate pentru industrii specifice (juridic, medical, financiar)
  • Produse SaaS: Cele cinci produse pe care le-ai construit în acest curs sunt doar începutul
  • Training și ateliere: Învață-i pe alții ceea ce ai învățat — cererea pentru educație AI este enormă

Înțelegi mecanismele de atenție, dinamica antrenamentului, funcțiile de pierdere și tokenizarea la un nivel fundamental. Această cunoaștere te face să ieși în evidență în orice rol legat de AI.

7. Certificatul de Curs și Descărcarea Proiectului

Finalizarea Cursului

Pentru a finaliza oficial Cursul LLM al ADD Academy:

Rămâi Conectat

Στάδιο 7: Πλατφόρμα NeuralForge

Μάθημα 51: Τελικό Capstone — Ανάπτυξη του Πλήρους Συστήματος LLM

Από το Μηδέν στην Ανάπτυξη — Το Ταξίδι σας στο AI Ολοκληρώθηκε

~35 λεπτά ανάγνωση | Αρχάριο–Ενδιάμεσο | Το τελευταίο μάθημα

Συγχαρητήρια — Τα Καταφέρατε

Αφιερώστε μια στιγμή για να εκτιμήσετε αυτό που καταφέρατε. Πενήντα ένα μαθήματα πριν, ξεκινήσατε με μια απλή ερώτηση: “Τι είναι ένα γλωσσικό μοντέλο;” Σήμερα, έχετε την απάντηση — όχι μόνο στη θεωρία, αλλά στην πράξη. Το κατασκευάσατε.

Ορίστε το ταξίδι που ολοκληρώσατε:

  • Στάδιο 1 — Θεμέλια: Μάθατε τι είναι τα tokens, πώς το κείμενο γίνεται αριθμοί και γιατί αυτό έχει σημασία.
  • Στάδιο 2 — Embeddings: Κατασκευάσατε στρώματα embedding που δίνουν νόημα στους αριθμούς και θεσιακές κωδικοποιήσεις που δίνουν νόημα στη σειρά.
  • Στάδιο 3 — Προσοχή: Υλοποιήσατε τον μηχανισμό προσοχής — τη βασική καινοτομία που κάνει δυνατό το σύγχρονο AI. Καταλαβαίνετε γιατί λειτουργεί, όχι μόνο ότι λειτουργεί.
  • Στάδιο 4 — Αρχιτεκτονική: Συναρμολογήσατε έναν πλήρη transformer GPT-2 από το μηδέν — προσοχή πολλαπλών κεφαλών, δίκτυα feed-forward, κανονικοποίηση στρώσεων, ολόκληρη η στοίβα.
  • Στάδιο 5 — Εκπαίδευση: Εκπαιδεύσατε το μοντέλο σας με πραγματικά δεδομένα χρησιμοποιώντας συναρτήσεις απώλειας, βελτιστοποιητές και προγραμματισμό ρυθμού μάθησης. Παρακολουθήσατε την καμπύλη απώλειας να πέφτει και καταλάβατε τι σημαίνει κάθε αριθμός.
  • Στάδιο 6 — Fine-tuning: Μάθατε LoRA, RAG, κβαντοποίηση και εξειδίκευση τομέα — τις τεχνικές που μετατρέπουν ένα βασικό μοντέλο σε χρήσιμο εργαλείο.
  • Στάδιο 7 — Πλατφόρμα: Κατασκευάσατε το NeuralForge, το συνδέσατε με πέντε προϊόντα SaaS και μάθατε την επιχειρηματική πλευρά του AI — κόστη, prompting και ανάπτυξη.
Τι Κατασκευάσατε: Ένα πλήρες, λειτουργικό σύστημα LLM με οπτική πλατφόρμα εκπαίδευσης, endpoints API, συνδέσεις με πέντε προϊόντα SaaS τροφοδοτούμενα από AI και τη γνώση να τα αναπτύξετε όλα στο διαδίκτυο. Οι περισσότεροι απόφοιτοι πληροφορικής δεν μπορούν να πουν ότι το έχουν κάνει αυτό.

1. Τι Έχετε Τώρα

Ας κάνουμε απογραφή όλων όσων κατασκευάσατε και μάθατε:

Το Εκπαιδευμένο Γλωσσικό Μοντέλο Mini GPT-2 σας

  • Ένα γλωσσικό μοντέλο βασισμένο σε transformer με ~85 εκατομμύρια παραμέτρους
  • Tokenization σε επίπεδο χαρακτήρα που κατασκευάσατε εσείς
  • Αυτοπροσοχή πολλαπλών κεφαλών (κωδικοποιήσατε κάθε πολλαπλασιασμό πινάκων)
  • Δίκτυα feed-forward με ενεργοποίηση GELU
  • Κανονικοποίηση στρώσεων και υπολειπόμενες συνδέσεις
  • Αυτοπαλινδρομική δημιουργία κειμένου με δειγματοληψία θερμοκρασίας και top-k

Η Πλατφόρμα NeuralForge σας

  • Οπτική διεπαφή εκπαίδευσης — παρακολουθήστε το μοντέλο σας να μαθαίνει σε πραγματικό χρόνο
  • Ελέγχοι fine-tuning — προσαρμόστε το μοντέλο σας για συγκεκριμένες εργασίες
  • Γεννήτρια API — δημιουργήστε κώδικα ενσωμάτωσης για οποιοδήποτε προϊόν SaaS
  • Playground — δοκιμάστε prompts και μηνύματα συστήματος διαδραστικά
  • Αξιολόγηση μοντέλου — μετρήστε την ποιότητα με πολλαπλές μετρικές

Πέντε Ενσωματώσεις Προϊόντων GenAI SaaS

  • PixelForge — βελτίωση prompt εικόνας
  • ClipCraft — δημιουργία σεναρίων βίντεο
  • ProseAI — επαναγραφή κειμένου σε πολλαπλούς τρόπους
  • TruthLens — ανάλυση κειμένου και ανίχνευση μοτίβων
  • DocMind — ερωτήσεις-απαντήσεις εγγράφων και σύνοψη

Επαγγελματική Γνώση

  • Κόστη API AI σε έξι μεγάλους παρόχους (Μάθημα 48)
  • Τεχνικές μηχανικής προτροπών για συστήματα παραγωγής (Μάθημα 49)
  • Αρχιτεκτονική ενσωμάτωσης για προϊόντα SaaS τροφοδοτούμενα από AI (Μάθημα 50)
  • Ροές εργασίας ανάπτυξης για εφαρμογές web

2. Βήμα-προς-Βήμα Οδηγός Ανάπτυξης

Αυτός ο οδηγός είναι γραμμένος για αρχάριους. Δεν απαιτείται γραμμή εντολών. Κανένα τερματικό. Μόνο το πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας και μερικά κλικ.

Πριν Ξεκινήσετε: Βεβαιωθείτε ότι έχετε βαθμολογηθεί τουλάχιστον με 80% σε όλα τα κουίζ του μαθήματος. Αυτό απαιτείται για να κατεβάσετε το πλήρες αρχείο zip του έργου από το NeuralForge.

Βήμα 1: Κατεβάστε το Έργο σας από το NeuralForge

  1. Ανοίξτε το NeuralForge στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας
  2. Πλοηγηθείτε στην ενότητα “Export” ή “Download”
  3. Ελέγξτε ότι η βαθμολογία κουίζ σας δείχνει 80% ή υψηλότερα
  4. Κάντε κλικ στο “Download Project ZIP”
  5. Αποθηκεύστε το αρχείο στον υπολογιστή σας (θα ονομάζεται κάτι σαν neuralforge-project.zip)
  6. Αποσυμπιέστε το αρχείο — δεξί κλικ και επιλέξτε “Extract All” (Windows) ή διπλό κλικ (Mac)

Τώρα πρέπει να έχετε έναν φάκελο που περιέχει το πλήρες έργο σας: κώδικα μοντέλου, frontend, endpoints API, αρχεία ρύθμισης και ό,τι χρειάζεται για την ανάπτυξη.

Βήμα 2: Δημιουργήστε ένα Αποθετήριο GitHub

  1. Πηγαίνετε στο github.com στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας
  2. Συνδεθείτε (ή δημιουργήστε δωρεάν λογαριασμό αν δεν έχετε)
  3. Κάντε κλικ στο κουμπί + στην πάνω δεξιά γωνία
  4. Επιλέξτε “New repository”
  5. Ονομάστε το my-neuralforge-llm (ή οποιοδήποτε όνομα θέλετε)
  6. Ορίστε το σε Public (απαιτείται για δωρεάν ανάπτυξη στο Vercel)
  7. Τσεκάρετε “Add a README file”
  8. Κάντε κλικ στο “Create repository”

Βήμα 3: Ανεβάστε τα Αρχεία του Έργου σας

  1. Στη σελίδα του νέου αποθετηρίου σας, κάντε κλικ στο “uploading an existing file” (ο σύνδεσμος εμφανίζεται στην ενότητα γρήγορης ρύθμισης)
  2. Ανοίξτε τον αποσυμπιεσμένο φάκελο του έργου στον υπολογιστή σας
  3. Επιλέξτε όλα τα αρχεία και τους φακέλους μέσα στον φάκελο του έργου
  4. Σύρτε τα στην περιοχή ανεβάσματος στο GitHub
  5. Περιμένετε να ανέβουν όλα τα αρχεία (μπορεί να πάρει ένα λεπτό)
  6. Κυλήστε προς τα κάτω και κάντε κλικ στο “Commit changes”
Μεγάλα Αρχεία: Αν το GitHub λέει ότι ένα αρχείο είναι πολύ μεγάλο (πάνω από 25 MB), μπορεί να χρειαστεί να αφαιρέσετε αρχεία βαρών μοντέλου από το ανέβασμα. Ο κώδικας της πλατφόρμας θα λειτουργεί χωρίς προεκπαιδευμένα βάρη — οι χρήστες μπορούν να εκπαιδεύσουν το μοντέλο μέσω της διεπαφής NeuralForge.

Βήμα 4: Ανάπτυξη στο Vercel

  1. Πηγαίνετε στο vercel.com στο πρόγραμμα περιήγησής σας
  2. Κάντε κλικ στο “Sign Up” και συνδεθείτε με τον λογαριασμό GitHub σας
  3. Κάντε κλικ στο “Add New...” → “Project”
  4. Θα δείτε μια λίστα με τα αποθετήρια GitHub σας
  5. Βρείτε το my-neuralforge-llm και κάντε κλικ στο “Import”
  6. Το Vercel θα ανιχνεύσει αυτόματα το framework — αφήστε τις προεπιλογές
  7. Κάντε κλικ στο “Deploy”
  8. Περιμένετε 1–2 λεπτά ενώ το Vercel χτίζει και αναπτύσσει το έργο σας

Βήμα 5: Το LLM σας Είναι Live!

Όταν η ανάπτυξη τελειώσει, το Vercel θα σας δείξει ένα URL όπως:

https://my-neuralforge-llm.vercel.app

Κάντε κλικ σε αυτό. Η πλατφόρμα NeuralForge LLM σας είναι τώρα live στο διαδίκτυο. Οποιοσδήποτε με το URL μπορεί να τη χρησιμοποιήσει. Μοιραστείτε τη με φίλους, προσθέστε τη στο portfolio σας, βάλτε τη στο προφίλ LinkedIn σας.

Μόλις αναπτύξατε μια εφαρμογή AI στο διαδίκτυο. Αυτό είναι ένα πραγματικό επίτευγμα.

Βήμα 6: Ορίστε Μεταβλητές Περιβάλλοντος (Προαιρετικό)

Αν θέλετε να ενεργοποιήσετε το fallback σε εμπορικά APIs (ώστε τα προϊόντα SaaS σας να μπορούν να χρησιμοποιούν OpenAI ή Gemini όταν το προσαρμοσμένο μοντέλο σας δεν αρκεί), προσθέστε μεταβλητές περιβάλλοντος στο Vercel:

  1. Στον πίνακα ελέγχου Vercel, κάντε κλικ στο έργο σας
  2. Πηγαίνετε στο “Settings” → “Environment Variables”
  3. Προσθέστε τα κλειδιά που χρειάζεστε:
    • OPENAI_API_KEY = το κλειδί OpenAI σας
    • GOOGLE_API_KEY = το κλειδί Google AI σας (δωρεάν!)
  4. Κάντε κλικ στο “Save”
  5. Πηγαίνετε στο “Deployments” και κάντε κλικ στο “Redeploy” στην τελευταία ανάπτυξη

3. Σύνδεση των Προϊόντων SaaS σας

Τώρα που το LLM σας είναι αναπτυγμένο, μπορείτε να το συνδέσετε με καθένα από τα πέντε προϊόντα GenAI SaaS που κατασκευάσατε.

Για Κάθε Προϊόν SaaS:

  1. Ανοίξτε το έργο SaaS στον επεξεργαστή κώδικα ή στο GitHub
  2. Βρείτε το αρχείο .env (ή .env.local)
  3. Ορίστε το LLM_URL στο αναπτυγμένο URL του NeuralForge: 
    LLM_URL=https://my-neuralforge-llm.vercel.app
  4. Αν το προϊόν SaaS είναι επίσης αναπτυγμένο στο Vercel, προσθέστε αυτήν τη μεταβλητή περιβάλλοντος στον πίνακα ελέγχου Vercel για εκείνο το έργο
  5. Ξανα-αναπτύξτε το έργο SaaS

Αυτό ήταν. Τα προϊόντα SaaS σας είναι τώρα συνδεδεμένα με το αναπτυγμένο LLM σας. Όταν ένας χρήστης αλληλεπιδράσει με το PixelForge, το ProseAI ή οποιοδήποτε άλλο προϊόν, τα αιτήματα ρέουν στον server NeuralForge σας.

4. Ρύθμιση του Τοπικού Περιβάλλοντος Ανάπτυξης

Ενώ η αναπτυγμένη έκδοση τρέχει στο Vercel, μπορεί να θέλετε να τρέξετε το έργο και τοπικά για εκπαίδευση και πειραματισμό.

Εγκαταστήστε την Python

  1. Πηγαίνετε στο python.org
  2. Κάντε κλικ στο μεγάλο κουμπί “Download Python”
  3. Εκτελέστε το πρόγραμμα εγκατάστασης
    • Σημαντικό (Windows): Τσεκάρετε το κουτί που λέει “Add Python to PATH” πριν κάνετε κλικ στο Install
    • Mac: Ακολουθήστε τα προεπιλεγμένα βήματα εγκατάστασης
  4. Επαλήθευση: ανοίξτε ένα τερματικό ή γραμμή εντολών και πληκτρολογήστε python --version — πρέπει να δείτε Python 3.10 ή νεότερη

Εγκαταστήστε τις Εξαρτήσεις

Το έργο σας περιλαμβάνει ένα αρχείο requirements.txt με όλα τα πακέτα Python που χρειάζεστε. Ανοίξτε ένα τερματικό στον φάκελο του έργου και εκτελέστε:

pip install -r requirements.txt

Αυτό εγκαθιστά το PyTorch, το FastAPI και όλες τις άλλες εξαρτήσεις.

Χρήση IDE

Για την καλύτερη εμπειρία, χρησιμοποιήστε έναν επεξεργαστή κώδικα:

  • VS Code (δωρεάν): Κατεβάστε από code.visualstudio.com. Ανοίξτε τον φάκελο του έργου με File → Open Folder.
  • PyCharm Community (δωρεάν): Κατεβάστε από jetbrains.com/pycharm. Ανιχνεύει αυτόματα τα έργα Python.

5. Τι να Μάθετε Στη Συνέχεια

Έχετε χτίσει μια στερεή βάση. Ορίστε τα πιο σημαντικά επόμενα βήματα, ταξινομημένα κατά δυσκολία:

Επόμενα Βήματα για Αρχάριους

  • Δοκιμάστε tokenization BPE: Αντικαταστήστε τον tokenizer σε επίπεδο χαρακτήρα με Byte Pair Encoding για πολύ καλύτερη διαχείριση κειμένου. Η βιβλιοθήκη tokenizers του HuggingFace το κάνει εύκολο.
  • Εκπαιδεύστε με περισσότερα δεδομένα: Το μοντέλο σας βελτιώνεται με περισσότερα δεδομένα εκπαίδευσης. Δοκιμάστε άρθρα Wikipedia, βιβλία δημόσιου τομέα ή κώδικα από το GitHub.
  • Πειραματιστείτε με υπερπαραμέτρους: Δοκιμάστε διαφορετικούς ρυθμούς μάθησης, μεγέθη παρτίδας και μεγέθη μοντέλου. Δείτε πώς κάθε αλλαγή επηρεάζει την ποιότητα.

Ενδιάμεσα Επόμενα Βήματα

  • HuggingFace Transformers: Η βιβλιοθήκη transformers σας δίνει πρόσβαση σε χιλιάδες προεκπαιδευμένα μοντέλα. Δοκιμάστε να φορτώσετε το GPT-2 (την πλήρη έκδοση) ή το LLaMA.
  • Fine-tune στα δικά σας δεδομένα: Συλλέξτε δεδομένα από τον τομέα σας (επαγγελματικά emails, εισιτήρια υποστήριξης πελατών, αποθετήρια κώδικα) και βελτιστοποιήστε ένα μοντέλο ειδικά για την περίπτωση χρήσης σας.
  • Συνδεθείτε με πραγματικά εμπορικά APIs: Χρησιμοποιήστε τα APIs OpenAI, Anthropic ή Google για απαντήσεις ποιότητας παραγωγής ενώ κρατάτε το προσαρμοσμένο μοντέλο σας για μάθηση και πειραματισμό.
  • Χτίστε περισσότερα προϊόντα SaaS: Το μοτίβο που μάθατε (LLM + system prompt + API) μπορεί να εφαρμοστεί σε οποιαδήποτε εφαρμογή βασισμένη σε κείμενο.

Προχωρημένα Επόμενα Βήματα

  • Κλιμακώστε το μοντέλο: Αυξήστε τον αριθμό στρώσεων, κεφαλών προσοχής και διαστάσεων embedding. Ένα μοντέλο 300M παραμέτρων είναι εφικτό σε ένα καλό GPU.
  • Υλοποιήστε RLHF: Το Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback είναι η τεχνική που χρησιμοποιήθηκε για την εκπαίδευση του ChatGPT. Είναι το επόμενο σύνορο μετά το επιβλεπόμενο fine-tuning.
  • Πολυτροπικά μοντέλα: Προσθέστε δυνατότητες επεξεργασίας εικόνας ή ήχου στο μοντέλο σας.
  • Κατανεμημένη εκπαίδευση: Μάθετε να εκπαιδεύετε σε πολλαπλά GPUs ή μηχανήματα χρησιμοποιώντας PyTorch DDP ή DeepSpeed.

6. Οι Δυνατότητες Αυτού που Κατασκευάσατε

Η γνώση LLM σας ανοίγει την πόρτα για να χτίσετε:

Πρακτικές Εφαρμογές

  • Chatbots και εικονικοί βοηθοί: Υποστήριξη πελατών, bots FAQ, προσωπικοί βοηθοί
  • Δημιουργία περιεχομένου: Αναρτήσεις blog, περιεχόμενο κοινωνικών δικτύων, πρότυπα email, κείμενα μάρκετινγκ
  • Δημιουργία και ανάλυση κώδικα: Αυτοσυμπλήρωση, ανίχνευση σφαλμάτων, αξιολόγηση κώδικα, δημιουργία τεκμηρίωσης
  • Επεξεργασία εγγράφων: Σύνοψη, Q&A, εξαγωγή δεδομένων, μετάφραση
  • Εκπαίδευση: Εξατομικευμένη διδασκαλία, δημιουργία κουίζ, εξηγήσεις σε διαφορετικά επίπεδα
  • Δημιουργική γραφή: Δημιουργία ιστοριών, ποίηση, βοήθεια σεναριογραφίας

Επιχειρηματικές Ευκαιρίες

  • Συμβουλευτική AI: Οι εταιρείες χρειάζονται ανθρώπους που κατανοούν τα LLMs σε βάθος, όχι μόνο πώς να χρησιμοποιούν το ChatGPT

"""
Quick Start Script — Initialize and Train Your NeuralForge LLM

This script demonstrates how to:
1. Initialize your Mini GPT-2 model
2. Prepare training data
3. Train for a few steps
4. Generate text
5. Start the API server

Run this after installing dependencies:
    pip install -r requirements.txt
    python quick_start.py
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import math
import os
from typing import List, Optional


# ── Model Configuration ─────────────────────────────────────────
class GPT2Config:
    """Configuration for Mini GPT-2."""
    vocab_size: int = 256        # Character-level (ASCII)
    n_positions: int = 512       # Max sequence length
    n_embd: int = 384            # Embedding dimension
    n_layer: int = 6             # Number of transformer layers
    n_head: int = 6              # Number of attention heads
    dropout: float = 0.1
    bias: bool = True

    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        for k, v in kwargs.items():
            setattr(self, k, v)
        assert self.n_embd % self.n_head == 0


# ── Simple Character Tokenizer ───────────────────────────────────
class CharTokenizer:
    """Character-level tokenizer — built from scratch."""

    def encode(self, text: str) -> List[int]:
        return [ord(c) % 256 for c in text]

    def decode(self, tokens: List[int]) -> str:
        return "".join(chr(t) for t in tokens)


# ── Simplified GPT-2 Model ───────────────────────────────────────
class MiniGPT2(nn.Module):
    """A simplified GPT-2 for demonstration."""

    def __init__(self, config: GPT2Config):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config

        self.token_emb = nn.Embedding(
            config.vocab_size, config.n_embd)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(
            config.n_positions, config.n_embd)
        self.drop = nn.Dropout(config.dropout)

        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=config.n_embd,
                nhead=config.n_head,
                dim_feedforward=config.n_embd * 4,
                dropout=config.dropout,
                activation="gelu",
                batch_first=True,
                norm_first=True,
            )
            for _ in range(config.n_layer)
        ])

        self.ln_f = nn.LayerNorm(config.n_embd)
        self.head = nn.Linear(
            config.n_embd, config.vocab_size, bias=False)

        # Weight tying
        self.head.weight = self.token_emb.weight

        # Count parameters
        n_params = sum(
            p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
        print(f"Model initialized: "
              f"{n_params / 1e6:.1f}M parameters")

    def forward(self, idx: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        B, T = idx.shape
        pos = torch.arange(0, T, device=idx.device)

        tok_emb = self.token_emb(idx)
        pos_emb = self.pos_emb(pos)
        x = self.drop(tok_emb + pos_emb)

        # Causal mask
        mask = nn.Transformer.generate_square_subsequent_mask(
            T, device=idx.device)

        for block in self.blocks:
            x = block(x, src_mask=mask, is_causal=True)

        x = self.ln_f(x)
        logits = self.head(x)
        return logits

    @torch.no_grad()
    def generate(self, idx: torch.Tensor,
                 max_new_tokens: int = 200,
                 temperature: float = 0.8,
                 top_k: int = 40) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Generate text autoregressively."""
        for _ in range(max_new_tokens):
            # Crop to max positions
            idx_cond = idx[:, -self.config.n_positions:]
            logits = self(idx_cond)
            logits = logits[:, -1, :] / temperature

            # Top-k sampling
            if top_k > 0:
                v, _ = torch.topk(logits, top_k)
                logits[logits < v[:, [-1]]] = float("-inf")

            probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
            idx_next = torch.multinomial(probs, num_samples=1)
            idx = torch.cat([idx, idx_next], dim=1)

        return idx


# ── Training Function ────────────────────────────────────────────
def train_model(model: MiniGPT2, text: str,
                steps: int = 100, lr: float = 3e-4,
                batch_size: int = 4, seq_len: int = 128):
    """Train the model on text data."""
    tokenizer = CharTokenizer()
    tokens = torch.tensor(
        tokenizer.encode(text), dtype=torch.long)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        model.parameters(), lr=lr)
    model.train()

    print(f"\nTraining on {len(tokens)} tokens "
          f"for {steps} steps...")
    print(f"Batch size: {batch_size}, "
          f"Sequence length: {seq_len}")
    print("-" * 50)

    for step in range(steps):
        # Random batch
        starts = torch.randint(
            0, len(tokens) - seq_len - 1, (batch_size,))
        x = torch.stack(
            [tokens[s:s + seq_len] for s in starts])
        y = torch.stack(
            [tokens[s + 1:s + seq_len + 1] for s in starts])

        logits = model(x)
        loss = nn.functional.cross_entropy(
            logits.view(-1, logits.size(-1)),
            y.view(-1))

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
            model.parameters(), 1.0)
        optimizer.step()

        if step % 10 == 0:
            print(f"  Step {step:4d}/{steps} | "
                  f"Loss: {loss.item():.4f}")

    print(f"\nTraining complete! "
          f"Final loss: {loss.item():.4f}")
    return model


# ── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("=" * 50)
    print("NeuralForge Quick Start")
    print("=" * 50)

    # 1. Initialize model
    config = GPT2Config()
    model = MiniGPT2(config)
    tokenizer = CharTokenizer()

    # 2. Sample training data
    training_text = """
    The transformer architecture revolutionized natural
    language processing. At its core, the transformer
    uses self-attention mechanisms to process sequences
    in parallel, rather than sequentially like RNNs.
    This parallel processing enables much faster training
    on modern hardware. The key innovation is the
    attention mechanism, which allows each token to
    attend to all other tokens in the sequence.
    """ * 50  # Repeat for more training data

    # 3. Train
    model = train_model(
        model, training_text,
        steps=50, lr=3e-4)

    # 4. Generate text
    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print("Generating text...")
    print("=" * 50)

    prompt = "The transformer"
    input_ids = torch.tensor(
        [tokenizer.encode(prompt)])

    output_ids = model.generate(
        input_ids,
        max_new_tokens=200,
        temperature=0.8,
        top_k=40,
    )

    generated = tokenizer.decode(
        output_ids[0].tolist())
    print(f"\nPrompt: {prompt}")
    print(f"Generated: {generated}")

    # 5. Save model
    save_path = "neuralforge_model.pt"
    torch.save({
        "model_state_dict": model.state_dict(),
        "config": vars(config),
    }, save_path)
    print(f"\nModel saved to {save_path}")
    print(f"File size: "
          f"{os.path.getsize(save_path) / 1e6:.1f} MB")

    print("\n" + "=" * 50)
    print("Quick start complete!")
    print("Your NeuralForge LLM is ready.")
    print("=" * 50)
